description: Enterprise-gated. Update a registered Gateway deployment, its workspace or JWT-sub access, or rotate its authentication secret. Use get_deployment first to inspect current settings. Rotation returns the new secret once in this MCP transcript, so store it securely immediately. Enterprise-gated. Returns 403 on non-Enterprise Portkey plans.

allow_all_workspaces.description: Clear workspace restrictions and allow every workspace

deployment_config.description: Replacement Gateway configuration, or null to clear it

is_dataservice_hosted.description: Whether the deployment hosts its own data service

is_default.description: Whether this is the default deployment

is_playground_proxy_allowed.description: Whether Playground proxy traffic is allowed

jwt_subs_allowed.description: JWT subject values allowed to use the deployment

override_existing.description: Allow replacement of existing deployment settings

remove_subs_allowed.description: JWT subject values to remove from the allowlist

remove_workspaces_allowed.description: Workspace slugs to remove from the allowlist

rotate_auth.description: Rotate the one-time deployment authentication secret

tags.description: Replacement deployment tags, or null to clear all tags

workspaces_allowed.description: Workspace slugs this deployment may serve; empty allows all

name: update_deployment

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
